items.html:
Rodney Trott, an allrounder who bowls offspin and bats in the lower-order, made his first-class debut in an Intercontinental Cup match against Netherlands in 2006. Since then he has gone on to play one-day international cricket for Bermuda, making his debut against Kenya in October 2007. Trott was appointed captain of Bermuda's Under-19 squad for the 2008 World Cup.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
